policies.description: Replaces binary dry_false_penalty with continuous within-snapshot rank_pct of up_day_ratio_20, isolating the ranking-mechanism hypothesis (q010). Tests Falsifier-1 by preserving winner/non-winner separation without imposing a brittle threshold; satisfies design principle of decoupling ranking from risk control.

Falsifier-5 test for q010: removes dry penalty entirely; in high-vol regimes (vol_ratio_5_20>1.3) penalizes candidates failing EITHER mom_20 OR px_vs_ma50 thresholds (joint depletion proxy for absent post-entry stop). Tests whether downside control is achievable without pre-entry dry filter, addressing entity_3472243e0c/entity_4fdc3699fd-type ruins the penalty missed.

Two-gate allocation for q007: uniform quality scoring inputs (mom_20, vol_ratio_5_20, up_day_ratio_20) for all slots, plus distinct_1 industry mode forces slot-3 cash abstention when slots 1+2 share GICS sub-industry. top1_confidence capacity preserves cash option value; addresses entity_3adc078f01-type deep-pullback winners by requiring strong mom/vol as quality floor.

batch_rationale: Three policies target three distinct falsifiable mechanisms with non-overlapping feature sets and selection structures: (1) continuous breadth rank tests ranking-vs-risk-control partition for dry_false_penalty decoupling hypothesis (q010); (2) vol-regime quality gate tests Falsifier-5 whether downside control is achievable WITHOUT the dry filter via post-entry-style regime conditioning; (3) three-slot crowding with distinct industry mode + top1_confidence tests the single-industry crowding economic-meaning hypothesis (q007) while preserving cash option value. No coefficient variants — each encodes a different mechanism, different falsification target, different selection geometry.
